summary: Frontend-only iteration 11: validated PreCheck component gating. Browser (no window.monExam): FRA401 ExamIntro has no precheck elements, start-exam-btn enabled, exam-shell loads on click. Desktop mock (add_init_script injecting window.monExam.forbiddenApps returning Microsoft Teams): precheck-forbidden with precheck-app-Microsoft Teams visible, start-exam-btn disabled; after precheck-close-btn click, precheck-ok shown and start-exam-btn enabled. Desktop mock + HIS301 (antidote allowed): antidote-agent-hint paragraph visible in intro with Agent Antidote/Connectix guidance; after start, clicking tool-launch-antidote fires toast containing 'Ctrl+C+C' (no launchTool invocation). Regression: teacher login via /connexion with lynchs2757@gmail.com lands on /enseignant dashboard with exams listing (8 ouverts, 34 copies).
critical_code_review_comments: PreCheck.jsx key={a.label} may collide if two forbidden apps share label; prefer a.process or composite key.

ExamIntro reads desktop = !!window.monExam?.forbiddenApps at render time but useState(!desktop) initial only runs once; this is fine for session-long window.monExam but any post-mount injection won't reactivate PreCheck (acceptable).

ExamTopBar antidote branch bypasses desktopTools.launch regardless of installed state — correct per spec, but the title tooltip still says 'Cliquer pour ouvrir' when not running; toast is only informational.
